attributes.board_name: Alaska State Physical Therapy and Occupational Therapy Board (Division of Corporations, Business and Professional Licensing)

rules.accepted_credit_types: At least half of the hours from courses recognized by the Alaska PT Association, APTA, FSBPT, other state PT associations or other state PT licensing boards; AMA category 1 and 2 courses involving physical therapy; activities sponsored by an organization or university approved by the Alaska PT Association or APTA (12 AAC 54.420(a)). All activities must contribute directly to PT/PTA competency. 1 contact hour = min. 50 minutes; 1 CEU from a professional health care association = 10 contact hours; 1 semester credit = 15, 1 quarter credit = 10 contact hours. Not accepted: routine staff meetings, rounds, employment-required courses (CPR, first aid, OSHA training).
rules.new_licensee_rule: Licensed less than 12 months of the concluding period: 12 contact hours, or passing the NPTE/NPTE-PTA within 12 months before the license lapse date.
rules.audit_note: Board audits renewal applications at its discretion after each renewal period; audited licensees submit documentation within 30 days. Keep records 3 years; do not mail the CE worksheet or certificates unless requested.

topics.who: Board jurisprudence questionnaire on AS 08.84 and 12 AAC 54, documented at each renewal (12 AAC 54.405(a)); no hours assigned

rules.notes: Licenses expire June 30 of even-numbered years. Besides CE, each renewal needs continuing professional practice: at least 60 hours of physical therapy services in the period, or an alternative (passing the NPTE, 40 extra CE contact hours, an APTA-approved school review course, or a board-approved 150-hour internship). Active-duty military: half of the CE hours waived for the following renewal.
